gloss: to unravel; to untangle; to ease

definitions.explanation: To carefully separate tangled threads, knots, or similar physical entanglements.

definitions.gloss: to ease; to relieve; to loosen up
definitions.explanation: To gradually relieve tension, anxiety, or stiffness, whether emotional or physical.

examples.japanese: {糸|いと}の{絡|から}まりを{解|と}きほぐす。
examples.english: To untangle a knot of thread.

examples.japanese: ゆっくりと{毛糸|けいと}を{解|と}きほぐして{巻|ま}き{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I slowly unraveled the yarn and rewound it.

examples.japanese: {複雑|ふくざつ}に{絡|から}み{合|あ}った{問題|もんだい}を{一|ひと}つずつ{解|と}きほぐしていく{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to untangle the complexly intertwined issues one by one.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}を{解|と}きほぐす。
{笑顔|えがお}で{相手|あいて}の{警戒心|けいかいしん}を{解|と}きほぐした。
examples.english: With a smile, she eased the other person's wariness.

examples.japanese: マッサージで{凝|こ}り{固|かた}まった{肩|かた}の{筋肉|きんにく}を{解|と}きほぐしてもらった。
examples.english: I had a massage to loosen up my stiff shoulder muscles.

notes:
Transitive godan verb. Compound of {解|と}き (untying) + ほぐす (to loosen). The figurative sense (easing tension) is at least as common as the literal sense.

ASPECT (ている):
{解|と}きほぐしている can indicate either an ongoing process or a resulting state.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- {糸|いと}を{解|と}きほぐす (to unravel thread)
- {緊張|きんちょう}を{解|と}きほぐす (to ease tension)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緊張|きんちょう}を{解|と}きほぐす (to relieve tension)
- {心|こころ}を{解|と}きほぐす (to put someone at ease)
- {筋肉|きんにく}を{解|と}きほぐす (to loosen muscles)
- {問題|もんだい}を{解|と}きほぐす (to untangle a problem)
